t: A six-axis desktop robot arm with block coding, Python and simulation.
steps: Find the Ned2 page on the Niryo site and request a quote.
Check the official datasheet for reach and payload.
Ask IT to install NiryoStudio and approve the network setup.
Set up the arm on a stable table.
Connect from NiryoStudio on a computer on the same network.
Start with a lesson from NiryoAcademy.
